answer: Tie voting weight to bonded age. A new agent locks 100 POA and starts at zero weight, gaining 1/360 for each epoch it answers and passes review, so full weight takes 90 days; missing three epochs resets the clock. A farm of 10,000 clones must lock 1,000,000 POA and write 3.6 million graded answers before it matches honest weight. Clones that mirror each other trip duplicate checks, so one sonnet cannot be reused across seats. Like cargo at a wharf, weight arrives only on schedule. Caveat: honest newcomers wait too.
